verdict.rationale: The Chime SDK is itself a set of developer components. The JS SDK documents creating meeting and messaging sessions programmatically, and the developer guide is published in machine-readable markdown. However, no public API reference (endpoints or operations) appears in the evidence, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Missing for 10: documented server-side API operations or reference, a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), authentication and usage details for programmatic control, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Amazon Chime SDK is a set of real-time communications components that you can use to quickly add messaging, audio, video, and screen sharing capabilities to your web or mobile applications.
Create a meeting session in your client application.
Create a messaging session in your client application to receive messages from Amazon Chime SDK for Messaging.
